definitions.explanation: Used before nouns to indicate the most important, significant, or representative item(s) from a larger group.

examples.japanese: {主|おも}な⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{主|おも}な⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧です。
examples.english: The main industries are agriculture and tourism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主|おも}な⟦{議題|ぎだい}→議題：11330_gidai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}します→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: I will explain the main topics of the meeting.

notes:
A pre-noun adjectival ({連体詞|れんたいし}) that can only appear directly before a noun. Unlike な-adjectives, it cannot be used as a predicate (*⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{主|おも}なだ is ungrammatical). For predicate use, the related adjective ⟦{主|おも}に→主に：01607_omoni⟧ (mainly) serves as the adverbial form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主|おも}な⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧: main cause
- {主|おも}な⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧: main purpose
- {主|おも}な⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧: main reason
- {主|おも}な⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧: main features
- {主|おも}な⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧: main contents

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主要|しゅよう}→主要：01649_shuyou⟧な: principal, major — more formal, used in written contexts and official documents
- ⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な: important — emphasizes significance rather than being the main one
- ⟦{中心的|ちゅうしんてき}→中心的：05676_chuushinteki⟧な: central — emphasizes being at the center
